name: Explore TUYOs Rewards
summary: Browse the TUYOs rewards program — earn points, invite friends, and view the leaderboard

steps.title: TUYOs dashboard
steps.action: Tap Rewards tab (4th in bottom bar)
steps.description: TUYOs rewards dashboard. Balance: 0. Four action buttons: Get TUYOs, Invite friends, Leaderboard, Redeem (coming soon). Invite code: 18FTN9 with 'SINCE MARCH 2026' member badge. Rewards Breakdown grid: CARD (0), EARN (0), CONVERT (0), REFERRAL (0).

steps.title: Get TUYOs
steps.description: Bottom sheet carousel explaining how to earn TUYOs. Visible card: 'Pay with Tuyo Card — Get 0.50 TUYOs per dollar spent.' Example: Spend $100 → earn 50 TUYOs. Carousel pagination dots (4 pages). Left/right navigation arrows.
steps.changes: Bottom sheet slid up with Get TUYOs carousel over rewards dashboard.

steps.title: Invite friends
steps.description: Referral screen. Personal invite code: 18FTN9 with copy button. Stats: Direct (0), Second Level (0). Two referral tiers: Direct referrals — get 20% of TUYOs rewarded to your referrals. Second level referrals — get 10% of all TUYOs rewarded to your referrals' referrals. Purple 'Share your invite' button. 'Become an ambassador' link at bottom.
steps.changes: Full-screen referral view replaced the bottom sheet.

steps.title: Leaderboard
steps.description: League screen with five tier badges displayed horizontally. Message: 'You're not part of any league yet. Earn TUYOs and climb the leaderboard.' Info button top-right.
steps.changes: Navigation pushed leaderboard screen. Back chevron top-left.

notes: Steps 2-4 are each accessed from the TUYOs dashboard (step 1). They are branches, not sequential.
